discord_add_multiple_reactions.why: Adds several emoji reactions; no free text

discord_add_reaction.why: Adds an emoji reaction; no free text

discord_create_category.why: Creates a server category; structure only, no message text

discord_create_forum_post.why: Creates forum post with agent-written title and content

discord_create_text_channel.why: Creates a channel with optional topic; no message sent

discord_create_webhook.why: Returns webhook URL and token, which are credentials

discord_delete_category.why: Deletes a category; no text content

discord_delete_channel.why: Deletes a channel; no text content

discord_delete_forum_post.why: Deletes a forum thread; no text content

discord_delete_message.why: Deletes a channel message; no text content

discord_delete_webhook.why: Deletes a webhook; no text content

discord_edit_category.why: Renames or moves a category; structure only

discord_edit_webhook.why: Edits webhook name and avatar; no message text

discord_get_forum_channels.why: Lists forum channel names and ids

discord_get_forum_post.why: Reads forum thread messages other members wrote

discord_get_server_info.why: Returns server structure and member count

discord_login.why: Logs the bot in with its configured token

discord_remove_reaction.why: Removes an emoji reaction; no free text

discord_reply_to_forum.why: Posts agent-written reply in a forum thread

discord_send.why: Posts agent-written message to a Discord text channel

discord_send_webhook_message.why: Posts agent-written content and username via webhook
